title: Tenma Saki — Fun Like A Dream〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The night before the show
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, I'm all set for tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The show's tomorrow...
I can't believe it's already here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But we've been working super duper hard to make sure we're able to put on the best performance ever!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sure... Yeah, I know we're gonna!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But still...
<Hiya, Sakki!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Rin! What's up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<The show's tomorrow, right?
I came over to see how you're doing!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm really glad you came. I'm actually feeling a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You're worried?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm pretty sure we've done everything we can, and a part of me does feel really excited...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm still worried that Free Cluster's fans aren't really gonna enjoy our performance.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A lot of people on social media don't seem happy that we're the ones opening for them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?! I see...>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I know we have to make sure those people also have fun, but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Sakki...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Don't worry!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <After watching you and the others practice, Sakki, I know that you all work really hard to make sure that everybody has fun!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So I know they're gonna love your performance!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Don't worry!
I guarantee that they're all gonna have lots of fun when you play!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're right... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, also!
I just happen to know a magic spell that can help you relax when you're feeling nervous☆>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A magic spell...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, MEIKO and the others helped me come up with it!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <First, open up your hand like this!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... Like this?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then, pretend to write the names of the people you care about the most on your palms, with your finger!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Make sure you're clearly picturing their faces in your head!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The people I care about the most...
That's Ichi, Hona, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Done...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Now, pretend to gobble them up!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... Nom!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That's weird... My heart is starting to feel really warm...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <How do you feel? Less nervous?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah...! I think I feel a lot better now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really? That's great!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <This spell's designed to make it feel like those people are right next to you!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like they're right next to me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yup! It's always comforting to know that the people you care about most are right there with you, yeah?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's why we came up with a spell that makes it feel like they're right there!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see. That explains why I feel so relieved.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Sakki?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin...!
I just remembered something big, thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm still a little worried about tomorrow's show. A part of me can't help but feel nervous...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm not going out there alone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi, Hona, Shiho...
All my favorite people are gonna be there with me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And you and the others will be there, rooting for us...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'm starting to think that we'll do just fine!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! We'll be right there cheering for you!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're gonna put on the best show ever tomorrow!
